micro_policies.name: Governing Law Clause
micro_policies.description: Ensure contract specifies governing law and jurisdiction clearly.
micro_policies.check: Must include governing law, e.g., 'This agreement is governed by the laws of...'

micro_policies.name: Termination Notice
micro_policies.description: Minimum 30 days notice required for termination without cause.

micro_policies.name: Indemnification
micro_policies.description: Vendor must indemnify the company against legal claims from third parties.
micro_policies.check: Missing or vague indemnity → High risk

micro_policies.name: Payment Terms
micro_policies.description: Payment period must not exceed 60 days from invoice date.

micro_policies.name: Late Fee Clause
micro_policies.description: Late payment fee clause must be defined.

micro_policies.name: Contract Value Threshold
micro_policies.description: Contracts above $500,000 must require CFO approval.

micro_policies.name: Data Protection
micro_policies.description: Must comply with GDPR or equivalent data laws.

micro_policies.name: Data Retention
micro_policies.description: Contract must define data retention and deletion timelines.

micro_policies.name: Confidentiality
micro_policies.description: NDA or confidentiality clause must be included.

micro_policies.name: Performance SLAs
micro_policies.description: Include clear service levels and uptime commitments.

micro_policies.name: Renewal Clause
micro_policies.description: Auto-renewal should not exceed 1 year without mutual consent.

micro_policies.name: Audit Rights
micro_policies.description: Organization must have audit rights for vendor compliance.
